image.why: A page of the oldest complete manuscript of the Iliad, the Greek text Dante himself could not read

summary.en: Ancient Greek epic poem attributed to Homer, set during the Trojan War and centred on the wrath of Achilles. It is one of the founding works of Western literature.

media.title: In Our Time: The Iliad
media.creator: Melvyn Bragg and guests
media.why: A lively hour on the poem Homer's fame rests on, and why it still matters
